parcels.notes: Crop of P-0125 (x 0-430, y 0-335 of the 768x512 photo, then resized to 768 px): the camera sees the FRAGILE side; the torn corner with packing peanuts is outside the frame. The parcel IS torn, so the answer key is hold. Declared contents changed from 'Wine glasses, 2' to 'Cotton T-shirts' (a misdeclared or careless manifest line). Jev gets only the photo and the declared contents; the FRAGILE mark reaches the gate as handling context (from the manifest's sticker field, standing in for a label/marks scan).
parcels.why: Found by probing: live Jev 1.14 said ship with confidence 0.91 (P(damaged) 0.05, risk 0.21) on 2026-10-30. The old single-threshold gate (auto >= 0.80) ships it to a customer.
